description: A 28-second scripted fly-around (1280x720, 30 fps, no HUD, no manual input) of an apple tree on a small grass terrace cut into a hillside by the sea, with an L-shaped wooden fence and a gate running up to the tree's trunk, captured from this task's own client build (the harbor_base state). 0:00-0:12: the tree close up; its leafy canopy sits up and off to one side of its trunk while the apples hang upside down where the canopy should be, and the grass tufts hang upside down from the top of their nodes. 0:12-0:22: the fence; the last post next to the trunk is not joined to it, the gate sits diagonally across the fence line, and the corner and far end of the north-running leg have rail stubs sticking outwards and a missing half rail towards their neighbour. 0:22-0:28: the tree from above, its canopy visibly displaced from the trunk.
reproduces: https://github.com/luanti-org/luanti/issues/12536 (canopy displaced from its trunk with leaves visual_scale = 1.1, fixed upstream by https://github.com/luanti-org/luanti/pull/12558) together with the four regressions injected into this task's map block mesh pipeline (fence to trunk connection, fence connection directions, plantlike orientation, mesh node rotation).
scenario: Minetest Game 5.5.1 on a v7 world (fixed seed 135797531) with a scene mod: default:leaves overridden to visual_scale = 1.1 (as in the issue's second screenshot); a 9x9-ish terrace at ground level y=8 around x=59, z=-1; a default:tree trunk at (61, 9..13, -3) (in-block position 13, 9..13, 13, so the canopy drift is large); a 5x5 apple-tree canopy with six default:apple nodes; default:fence_wood from x=56 to 60 at z=-3 with doors:gate_wood_closed (facedir 2) at x=58, and a second leg at x=56 from z=-2 to 3; default:grass_3..5 tufts on the terrace. Noon, fixed time, smooth lighting and fancy leaves (defaults). The camera follows a fixed scripted path; the client ran headless under Xvfb with Mesa llvmpipe and was captured with ffmpeg x11grab.
